title: Docs — in-shell documentation index
description: OS app that indexes this instance's documentation: the public /install guide it serves itself, the GitHub repo, the CLI reference, the security model and the deeper architecture docs. Session-aware: a signed-out visitor also gets Sign in / Install your own / GitHub actions, since a signed-out shell is running on mock data and those are the only two useful next steps. Holds the links that used to ship as default quicklinks, so quicklinks can go back to being the owner's own shortcuts.

peers.reason: reads session status to show the signed-out actions
